kpi_details.pbb_framework: Cincinnati implemented Performance Based Budgeting (PBB) for the first time in the FY2026-27 biennial (documented on Introduction page xvii, pdf-page 22). The Office of Performance and Data Analytics (OPDA) built a department-wide Service Catalog: individual services -> Service Groups, each with performance measures (including volume measures) and performance goals; quarterly performance reports feed a dashboard; Department Directors sign annual Performance Agreements.
kpi_details.measure_type_definitions_captured: Glossary (pdf-page 325/330, printed 290/296) defines EFFECTIVENESS MEASURE (outcome/quality measures, e.g. % lane miles in good condition) and EFFICIENCY MEASURE (cost per unit of output/outcome, e.g. cost per million gallons delivered). These are the measure-taxonomy definitions for the yield side.
kpi_details.quantitative_note: The Departmental Budgets section (printed pages 97-286, pdf-pages 132-321) uses Service Catalog/Service Group structure with agency descriptions, but the volume contains narrative descriptions rather than populated numeric performance-measure tables - keyword scan across all 333 pages found no measure-value tables. Numeric KPI values likely live in Volume II / Service Catalog appendix or the OPDA dashboard, not in this operating volume. Framework terms and structure are captured here for the yield-side ingest; treat KPI-numbers as still-to-fetch for Cincinnati.
